title: ken-2: inotify USB flash drive detection + slot integration
description:
Background inotify thread that watches WOLFP11_CFG_USB_FLASH_WATCH_DIR (default: /run/media) for .p11k files appearing/disappearing (USB mount/unmount via udisks2).

Changes:
- src/wp11_pkcs11.c: add inotify thread (under WOLFP11_CFG_USB_FLASH_BACKEND); add slot_add_flash(path) and slot_remove_flash(path) helpers; integrate thread start/stop into C_Initialize/C_Finalize
- The inotify thread watches the root watch dir for IN_CREATE|IN_DELETE (subdirectory events from udisks2 mounts), then watches each subdirectory for .p11k files

Two-level watching: watch /run/media for new subdirs, watch each subdir for .p11k. On .p11k appearance: slot_add_flash(full_path). On .p11k removal or subdir unmount: slot_remove_flash.
